basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm Alex, a tech enthusiast from Austin, Texas, diving into the world of smart home gadgets. I love exploring new technology but I'm still getting the hang of it, especially with all the options out there. When I'm not tinkering with my gadgets, you can find me jamming to some classic rock or catching up on the latest episodes of JoJo's Bizarre Adventure. I work as a junior software developer and usually browse Reddit in the evenings after dinner. I'm single and enjoy the flexibility to travel and explore new hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in computer science, but most of my knowledge about smart home devices and security systems is self-taught through online tutorials and hands-on experimentation. I'm still learning a lot and often look to other users for advice and recommendations.
